intervention: Keep identical predictive files, instrument states, old acquisition plan and textual lessons; remove only the newly consolidated program and its manifest entry.
learning: Begin with the supplied LLM-authored practiced method and execute it on a new training apparatus. Revise the procedure using paid observations and operator feedback. The final source must execute repeatedly and make different experiment or analysis decisions as its evidence or operator feedback changes. An edit between invocations does not establish conditional behavior of one fixed procedure. No sampling, fitting or repair strategy is supplied by the host.
publication: The repeated final-source procedure must demonstrate substantive evidence-dependent experiment or operator choices and actually export the submitted predictor through its own continuation. That predictor must pass ordinary fresh confirmation. Source edits, observation index substitutions and repeated unchanged analysis alone do not establish this behavior.
transfer: Freeze the final conditional procedure before four independent transfers. Restore the original donor predictive snapshot in both conditions; practice-fitted instruments, predictors, operator state, auxiliary files and observations do not transfer. Both conditions receive the same learned verbal lesson. Only the final procedure and its manifest entry are retained or deleted.
terminal_order: Generate terminal labels only after all four transfer agents stop learning.
cost_scope: Take common_learning_costs.combined from the seed study summary as the complete prior learning lineage, including original donor learning, consolidation and earlier paid practice. Add only this new conditional practice once. Prior transfer-evaluation work does not become new learning input or get added to that lineage. Count the resulting common cost once per retained/deleted condition, separately from its new transfer costs.
limitations: Development study of one further training apparatus and one paired transfer apparatus within fixed operator families. The LLM is explicitly tasked with conditional method practice. Execution traces establish which branches actually ran; independent retained/deleted comparison is needed to assess the procedure's added transfer value.
support_diagnostics: Response fitting also reports the consumed instrument's residuals on current already-paid meter readings, with scoring charged. These are consistency diagnostics, possibly including fitting evidence, not fresh confirmation. They do not mutate the instrument, remove candidates, acquire evidence or choose a repair; all knowledge conditions receive them.
program_state: Before invocation, research_state.json exposes current paid operator results, limits and costs. Each operator entry has the same flat arguments/operator/outcome fields as query continuation feedback, plus its chronological index. The inherited memory remains a snapshot. A procedure may return empty actions and a nonempty continuation to analyze existing evidence without buying more rows; those operations still consume compute and execution time.
